query_normalized: predicting gut microbiome response to dietary interventions using publicly available data biology
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (b) by measuring the dependent variable (diet-microbiome associations) on the user's specific domain (gut microbiome and dietary interventions), providing a foundational dataset and NLP methodology for extracting the relationships necessary to build predictive models. It also aligns with criterion (d) as a canonical reference for the specific task of mining diet-microbiome literature, which is a prerequisite step for utilizing publicly available data in this field.
